cfc.def: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs): stable, nontoxic gases of chlorine, fluorine and carbon once used as refrigerants, propellants in spray cans and in foams. In the stratosphere, UV breaks them and frees chlorine that destroys ozone.

ozone-depletion.def: The thinning of the stratospheric ozone layer by chlorine and bromine from CFCs and halons. The ozone hole is the severe seasonal thinning over Antarctica each spring.
